questions.q: What does "low-code" mean in the context of Power Automate?
options: You build automation by configuring connectors, triggers, and actions visually, instead of writing integration code by hand
The product only works for companies with fewer than 50 employees
It requires knowledge of a scripting language like Python
It is a free, open-source alternative to Power Platform
questions.explain: Low-code means automations are assembled by configuring pre-built connectors, triggers, and actions in a visual designer rather than hand-written integration code.

questions.q: Castlebridge Logistics needs to automate clicks and data entry inside a legacy freight-rate desktop application that has no modern connector. Which Power Automate capability fits?
options: Cloud flows
Process mining
Desktop flows (RPA)
Power BI dataflows
questions.explain: Desktop flows provide robotic process automation (RPA) that operates desktop applications directly, which is exactly what's needed when no cloud connector exists.

questions.q: What is process mining used for?
options: Sending approval emails to managers
Analyzing existing system logs to understand how a business process actually runs before automating it
Compiling flows into desktop applications
Designing the visual layout of a Power BI report
questions.explain: Process mining studies your existing system logs to surface bottlenecks and understand the real, current state of a process, before any automation is built.

questions.q: Which Microsoft product suite does Power Automate belong to?
options: Microsoft Power Platform, alongside Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Pages
Microsoft Office, alongside Word and Excel only
Azure DevOps
Dynamics 365 exclusively, with no relation to other products
questions.explain: Power Automate is one of four tools in the Power Platform: Power BI, Power Apps, Power Pages, and Power Automate.

questions.q: Why might Castlebridge Logistics prefer Power Automate over hiring a developer to write custom integration code?
options: Power Automate cannot connect to Microsoft 365 apps
Business users can build and own flows themselves using apps they already use, without a developer or deployment
Custom code is always faster to build than a flow
Power Automate requires a dedicated server to run
questions.explain: Power Automate lets business users configure connectors to apps they already use, like SharePoint and Outlook, without needing a developer or a formal deployment process.
